Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: detailed pixel-art ANIMATION SEQUENCE REFERENCE BOARD, not runtime spritesheet, for original top-down3/4 high fantasy RPG TAN NGUYET.
Input image1 is identity/style reference only. Redraw the specified ONE character in a strict six ROW by four COLUMN motion study:24 individual full-body figures. Large portrait layout approximately1536x2048. Header then columns01,02,03,04. Row labels exactly IDLE,WALK,ATTACK,HURT,DEATH,DODGE. Every row is a true ordered four-frame sequence of the SAME character performing the named action; do NOT substitute four different races or outfits. All four frames must exist and be visibly distinct. Maintain same head/body proportions, clothing details, weapon, scale, top-left light, camera angle within the study. Top-down 3/4 with visible crown and shoulders; no side-scroller, no isometric.
Hand-crafted pixel art, crisp clusters and native-pixel outlines, limited shades and sharp metal/fabric highlights, no blurry smooth gradients/antialiasing. Clean flat dark slate #17222a board, fine ivory typography and thin muted-gold cell boundaries, enough padding for fully horizontal death body and weapon; no clipping. Align standing feet to a consistent within-cell ground line; do not enlarge/shrink character between frames.
Exactly these actions left-to-right:
IDLE01 neutral ready;02 slight inhale shoulders rise;03 exhale shoulders settle and fingers relax;04 slight cloth/hair settling back to ready. Subtle real frame differences.
WALK01 left leg forward;02 passing left planted;03 right leg forward;04 passing right planted. Arms counterbalance, not four running attacks.
ATTACK01 anticipation;02 committed strike/cast;03 follow-through;04 recovery to ready. Show class-specific clear action without screen-filling effects.
HURT01 bracing at impact;02 torso recoils back;03 lower/side recoil with weapon safe;04 recovering balance. Visible body bend and shoulder change, not mere recolor.
DEATH01 unsteady body leans;02 knees buckle and hand lowers;03 side fall halfway with body diagonal;04 fully collapsed side-lying body horizontal at ground, no kneeling final pose. Equipment stays present. No gore/no disintegration.
DODGE01 low anticipation crouch;02 lateral push-off;03 low lateral extension with clear weight and cloth trail;04 grounded recovery. Actual physical evasive motion, not teleport or sword strike. Tiny discrete dust only.
One figure per cell, no extra characters, enemies, HUD, environments, arrows, watermarks, illegible tiny explanatory text or copyrighted references. Do not lose ears/hair/weapon during motions.
Character: the HUMAN SWORDSMAN in reference row1 column2, balanced ordinary build, dark tied-back hair with short ponytail, charcoal-teal split tunic, shaped light steel shoulder/chest armor, brown leather belt/bracers/boots, practical steel sword with small warm-gold guard. Use the same single sword and same weapon hand in all24frames. ATTACK anticipation sword raised; strike a short bright edge arc; follow-through visible blade beyond front arm; recovery sword near hip. DuringDEATH final sword on ground next to the still holding hand, no duplicate sword. DODGE sword held back near body, free hand balances. Header exact "TAN NGUYET / B2 / SWORDSMAN MOTION".
